board: Keyes / Joy-IT KY-020 tilt switch module (black 3-pin sensor-kit board with blue ball switch; header S, + (middle), -)
reason: Modelled as an active-low digital sensor (ball switch from S to GND with on-board 10k pull-up to +, S LOW when contacts close on tilt); debounced driver; check passed on ESP32 and Pico in the first run.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://arduinomodules.info/ky-020-tilt-switch-module/ (S, middle +, -), confirmed by Joy-IT product image https://sensorkit.joy-it.net/files/files/sensors/KY-020/KY-020.png and https://protosupplies.com/product/tilt-ball-switch-module/
